notes: Colors are exact: taken from the site's own CSS custom properties and module-theme classes (--color-accent: 74 83 255 → #4a53ff; --module-background: #fff | #f3f5f9 | #000). Type scale normalized to rem from a fluid clamp() system — the site has no discrete steps, so these are the anchor values (12/14/16/20/24/32px UI; 50px mobile display; 100px section head; 120px desktop h1). Raw 13.6px/14.4px/12.99px/23.95px are browser-computed em fallbacks and were dropped. leading 0.8 is real, not a typo: the 120px h1 uses a 96px line-height. Tracking crosses zero by size — negative at display and body (-0.03em), positive on uppercase 12-14px labels (+0.1em ≈ raw 1.4px/14px). Radius: the 300px and 9999px pills both map to the pill tier; 3px/6px/9.35px one-offs dropped. Shadows are all near-transparent greys; the rgb(199,197,199) inset pair is a single decorative one-off and was dropped. craft.theme.supportsDark is false and its payload is degenerate (bg #fff, accent transparent) — the black sections are content grounds set per-section via --module-background, not a dark theme, so color.dark is omitted rather than invented; use the bg-dark / surface-dark / fg-on-dark roles instead. motion.scroll_effects entries for 'Join Now' color/background reported from==to in the raw probe (sampled mid-transition or same-ground stops) — the frames DO show the pill inverting white↔blue across sections, and the CSS rule [data-inview-theme="dark"] .cta > a { background:#fff; color:#000 } confirms it, so the effect is kept. Reduced motion is respected by inversion: base rules name the animation with no duration; duration+easing are added only inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference). The JS-driven hero parallax is NOT covered by that gate.
